description.zh-CN: hub：统一入口的下载中心排队执行所有模型下载，管理器重启或部署不会中断下载。manager：回退到两个管理器各自的旧下载队列，下载中心只提供模型库和搜索。修改后需要重启两个管理器。
description.en-US: hub: the model hub in service-entry queues and runs every model download, so manager restarts and deploys no longer interrupt them. manager: fall back to each manager's own legacy download queue; the hub then only serves the library and search. A change needs both managers restarted.
